title: Sagimet Biosciences Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Sagimet Biosciences Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the retirement of Chief Medical Officer Eduardo Martins, M.D., D.Phil. effective April 20, 2026, and the concurrent appointment of Andreas Grauer, M.D. as his replacement. The filing contains no information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Eduardo Martins, M.D., D.Phil. retired as Chief Medical Officer effective April 20, 2026
Dr. Martins will continue as an external scientific advisor
Andreas Grauer, M.D. appointed as new Chief Medical Officer effective April 20, 2026
Dr. Grauer previously served as CMO at Omeros Corporation (Oct 2023–Apr 2026)
The company is listed on Nasdaq Global Market under ticker SGMT
Filing signed by CEO David Happel on April 21, 2026
